phase_name: Phase 15-7/15-8 Pre-Execution Check Result Evidence Locking Design
phase_japanese_name: Phase 15-7/15-8 実行直前チェック結果の証跡固定ルール設計
purpose: Design cryptographic evidence locking procedures for Phase 18-2 and 18-3 pre-execution check results to prevent tampering and provide authoritative audit trails before measurement workflow execution

scope_1_phase18_2_check_result_locking.description: Design evidence locking for Phase 15-7 pre-execution check results (20 checks from Phase 18-2)

step_1_capture_check_results.action: Capture all 20 check results from Phase 18-2 (Groups 1-5) in JSON structure

step_2_compute_sha256_plus_hash.action: Compute SHA-256+ hash (or stronger: SHA-3, Blake2b) of complete JSON check results
step_2_compute_sha256_plus_hash.hash_input: Complete Phase 18-2 check result JSON serialized with consistent field ordering
step_2_compute_sha256_plus_hash.verification_note: Hash must be computed deterministically; JSON field order must be canonical

step_3_create_evidence_lock_record.action: Create immutable evidence lock record with hash, timestamp, and authority signature

lock_record_structure.timestamp_lock_created_utc: RFC 3339 format, must match check execution timestamp
lock_record_structure.tamper_detection_checksum: Secondary hash of (lock_id + authority_signature + timestamp) for early tamper alerts

step_4_store_evidence_lock_in_audit_trai.action: Store evidence lock record in immutable audit trail (append-only log)
step_4_store_evidence_lock_in_audit_trai.storage_format: JSON array, new lock records appended, never modified or deleted
step_4_store_evidence_lock_in_audit_trai.access_control: Read-only for Phase 15-7 workflow; Write-only via Phase 18-4 locking procedure
step_4_store_evidence_lock_in_audit_trai.integrity_verification: Verify storage success by re-reading and comparing hash against original lock_id

scope_2_phase18_3_check_result_locking.description: Design evidence locking for Phase 15-8 pre-execution check results (22-23 checks from Phase 18-3)

locking_procedure.step_1_to_4: Identical to scope_1 (steps 1-4) with Phase 18-3 check results (Groups 1-6, 22-23 checks)
phase_15_8_specific_considerations: Include Phase 15-7 result integration (Group 6) in locked evidence if Phase 15-7 pre-execution checks are READY_TO_EXECUTE
If sequential execution mode: require Phase 15-7 check result lock evidence in Phase 15-8 lock record
If parallel execution mode: Phase 15-8 lock can be independent of Phase 15-7 lock

lock_record_structure.evidence_hash_sha256_plus: SHA-256+ hash of Phase 18-3 complete check results

phase_15_7_integration.phase_15_7_results_hash: If sequential, include hash of Phase 15-7 check results for dependency proof

lock_record_structure.tamper_detection_checksum: Secondary hash for early tamper alerts

procedure_1_evidence_lock_integrity_veri.purpose: Before Phase 15-7/15-8 execution, verify evidence locks have not been tampered with

verification_steps.action: Read evidence lock record (lock_id, evidence_hash, authority_signature, timestamp)
verification_steps.verification: Confirm lock_id format matches expected pattern (EL_PHASE15_[7|8]_CHECKS_*)

verification_steps.action: Recompute SHA-256+ hash from original Phase 18-[2|3] check results JSON
verification_steps.verification: Compare recomputed hash against evidence_hash_sha256_plus in lock record. If mismatch → TAMPER_DETECTED

verification_steps.action: Verify authority signature validity (signature algorithm, expiry, revocation status)
verification_steps.verification: Confirm signature is ACTIVE and not expired. If invalid → TAMPER_DETECTED or AUTHORITY_REVOKED

verification_steps.action: Verify tamper_detection_checksum (secondary hash of lock_id + signature + timestamp)
verification_steps.verification: Recompute and compare. If checksum mismatch → TAMPER_DETECTED

verification_steps.action: Verify lock record exists in immutable audit trail and has not been deleted or modified
verification_steps.verification: Confirm audit trail append-only integrity. If missing from audit trail → EVIDENCE_LOSS_DETECTED

all_checks_pass.action: Proceed to Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement workflow execution

hash_mismatch.action: HALT execution. Alert authority. Initiate tampering investigation procedure (Phase 18-6)

signature_invalid_or_expired.action: HALT execution. Alert authority. Require re-authorization from current authority

audit_trail_missing.action: HALT execution. Critical security incident. Escalate to incident response

procedure_2_evidence_lock_chain_of_custo.purpose: Verify unbroken chain of custody from Phase 18-2/18-3 check execution → Phase 18-4 evidence locking → Phase 15-7/15-8 execution

link_1_phase18_2_to_18_4_evidence_lock.verification: Phase 18-4 evidence_hash must match hash of Phase 18-2 original JSON output
link_1_phase18_2_to_18_4_evidence_lock.timestamp_constraint: Phase 18-4 lock timestamp must be within 5 minutes of Phase 18-2 check execution timestamp
link_1_phase18_2_to_18_4_evidence_lock.authority_constraint: Phase 18-4 signer must match Phase 18-2 execution authority (or explicitly delegated signer)

link_2_18_4_evidence_lock_to_phase15_7_e.verification: Phase 15-7 execution must reference Phase 18-4 lock_id as prerequisite
link_2_18_4_evidence_lock_to_phase15_7_e.timestamp_constraint: Phase 15-7 execution timestamp must be after Phase 18-4 lock creation timestamp
link_2_18_4_evidence_lock_to_phase15_7_e.consistency: No Phase 18-2 check results may be modified between Phase 18-4 locking and Phase 15-7 execution

link_3_phase18_3_to_18_4_evidence_lock.verification: Phase 18-4 Phase 15-8 section must reference Phase 18-3 original check execution
link_3_phase18_3_to_18_4_evidence_lock.sequential_execution_link: If sequential mode: Phase 15-8 lock must reference Phase 15-7 lock_id and overall Phase 15-7 result hash

complete_unbroken_chain.action: Proceed to Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement workflow execution

timestamp_gap_or_mismatch.action: HOLD execution. Investigate time discrepancy. Require re-locking with current timestamp

authority_mismatch.action: HOLD execution. Verify delegation authority. Require explicit re-authorization

phase_18_4_completion_criteria: Evidence locking procedure (steps 1-4) designed for both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 check results
Verification procedure (two sub-procedures) designed to detect tampering and verify chain of custody
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
